units.failure: Act agent reported ok:false: BLOCKED, no files changed. UNIT-280 depends on a UI store and a Tailwind setup that are not in this worktree. (1) Step 1 imports `useUiStore` (drawerOpen/toggleDrawer), but no store file exists under game/frontend/src, and the `cn` helper the step uses is also missing. (2) Tailwind is not wired: there are no tailwind/postcss configs and no @tailwind directives in styles.css. package.json has an uncommitted diff adding zustand, tailwindcss, clsx, tailwind-merge, class-variance-authority, lucide-react, motion and @radix-ui/react-dialog, but none of them are in node_modules, so the classes would produce no CSS. Deleting the layout rules (Step 2) now would leave the game layout unstyled. (3) tests/layout.test.tsx asserts styles.css contains 'overflow-y: auto' and '@media (max-width: 768px)', so Step 2 would fail that test; test changes belong to Verify. (4) .ai-dlc has only UNIT-001..010 and no UNIT-280 or store/Tailwind unit, so the prerequisite cannot be confirmed. Baseline: case HEAD d3be040; approved scan v1, tip 9cda5131c65b08541fc685d8a0898d39a0e9e9fa. Unblock by landing the UI store and Tailwind setup first (install deps, add tailwind/postcss config and @tailwind directives), then having Verify update the CSS assertions in layout.test.tsx before Step 2 runs. The uncommitted package.json diff predates this run and was left untouched.
